title: DRV Argument-in-One-Page  -  REWRITE v2

canonical_node.axiom: The Master Equation is the integrated product of ten typed factors, each with a fixed mathematical domain, and the distinction between the factor C and the output chi is structural.
definitions: G: external negentropy influx rate, domain 0
E: signal propagation fidelity (channel capacity), domain 0
S_prod: entropy production rate, enters as S_eff = e^( S_prod), domain 0
chi: integrated output, not a factor
derivation: The Master Equation is defined as chi_total =  G*M*E*S_eff*T*K*R*Q*F*C dx dt.
Each factor has a fixed mathematical domain as per Definition 10 of the Formal Theory v1.0.
The entropy sign repair is explicit: S_eff = e^( S_prod), which is antitone in S_prod.
C is a factor; chi is the output; they are not the same.
The physical-spiritual bridge is summarized in the ten-factor table, with two canonical asymmetries: F is directional, C is sovereign.
Free will enters at Factor M (alignment cosine) per Axiom 3.
The reduced-form coherence equation is a slice of the Master Equation, not the full equation.
The Lowe Coherence Lagrangian is provisional and not Lean-verified.
The K-Drop argument is anchored to Factors G and K; the inference to intelligence is named-contestable.
canonical_node.action: The system must treat the Master Equation as the canonical unified equation, with each factor typed and the C/chi distinction enforced. It must not present the reduced-form equation as the full equation, nor the Lowe Lagrangian as verified, nor the K-Drop intelligence inference as established.
boundary: Does not claim the Lowe Coherence Lagrangian is Lean-verified.
Does not claim the five-pair fractal symmetry structure is canonical.
Does not claim the K-Drop intelligence inference is proven; it is named-contestable.
Does not claim the physical-spiritual bridge is a proof of theological claims; it is a formal mapping.
Does not claim the Master Equation is a physical law; it is a formal framework.
test: Check that the Master Equation uses dx dt, not dx dy dt.
Check that S_eff is used, not bare S.
Check that C is never included in the product as a factor.
Check that the reduced-form equation is labeled as a reduction.
Check that the Lowe Lagrangian is marked provisional.
Check that the K-Drop intelligence inference is marked named-contestable.

dg1_dependencies: FORMAL_VERIFICATION_PACKET_2026-05-10/ (Layer 1, Layer 2, Definition 10, Axiom 3, Formal Theory v1.0)
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a corrected, typed Master Equation with explicit domains and a clear C/chi distinction, and anchors the physical-spiritual bridge to canonical asymmetries.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the core argument that coherence is an integrated product of ten factors and that the framework has a physical-spiritual bridge.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If the Master Equation correction is removed, the framework reverts to mislabeled variables and a self-referential product, breaking the no-drift lock.

overstatement_risks: The Master Equation is presented as canonical but is not a physical law; it is a formal framework.
The physical-spiritual bridge may be read as proof of theological claims.
The K-Drop intelligence inference is marked contestable but could be overread.
The Lowe Lagrangian is provisional but may be cited as verified.
kill_conditions: If the Master Equation is shown to be internally inconsistent or not type-compatible.
If the Lean kernel does not verify the S_eff antitone property.
If the canonical Layer 2 table is contradicted by the Formal Theory v1.0.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the Master Equation and the S_eff antitone property in Lean.

plain_summary: This document is a rewrite of the DRV argument-in-one-page, correcting the Master Equation to use typed factors with explicit domains, fixing the entropy sign, and clarifying the C/chi distinction. It also reframes the Ten Laws table, marks the Lowe Lagrangian as provisional, and anchors the K-Drop argument to specific factors. The document is a canonical revision but does not establish new proofs; it is a correction and clarification of existing formal structure.
